text: The selected LSOA, Kingston upon Hull 030C, has a moderate GeoSensitivity of **-1.51**, ranked 14th of 168 in Hull, indicating a notable geographic contribution compared to other areas but not strong in absolute terms. Its GeoSensitivity forms part of a significant high–high spatial cluster (p=0.024). Latitude effect is slightly negative (−0.043) and longitude effect positive (0.32). Explanation stability and accuracy are well evaluated, but causation and pattern scale remain unestablished.
